text: {"lessons":["I can stay patient through ordinary fluctuations; I do not need to trade just because the account value changes.","Selling Stock B and Stock D at gains felt rewarding, but I should judge a sale by my plan and the portfolio’s needs, not by the pleasure of locking in a profit.","Buying Stock B and Stock D again at higher prices reminds me not to anchor on my past sale prices or average cost; with unpredictable prices, I should focus on risk, diversification, and my long-term plan."]}
